fields.name: X
fields.evidence: GameEngine.dll+0x13B160 (Toolkit, ls::ClusterSystem::SetupNewCluster(..., EntityHandle, Vector4i<int>, ...)) adds the component through GameEngine.dll+0x12C450 (SetupComponentFrameStorage size 0x10, type id in the global at GameEngine.dll+0xF0A6E4, registered by GameEngine.dll+0x16150 as ls::ClusterIndexComponent) and copies the four ints of its Vector4i argument (the fourth argument) into it; then ClusterPositionX = the first of those ints times cellSize. Live: small signed ints (0..0xFFFFFFFF = -1).

fields.name: Y
fields.evidence: Same copy (second int of the Vector4i argument); ClusterPositionY = that int times cellSize. Live: 0, 1, 0xB.

fields.name: Z
fields.evidence: Same copy (third int of the Vector4i argument); ClusterPositionZ = that int times cellSize. Live: small signed ints (down to -2).

fields.name: Level
fields.evidence: Same copy (fourth int of the Vector4i argument); SetupNewCluster uses it as a size exponent: half-cell = 1 shifted left by it (written to ClusterBoundMax), cell = 2 shifted left by it; radius = cell*0.5*sqrt2 + half-cell. Live: 1..0x1C (0x1C probably the HLOD / cull-trigger special clusters). SE's ClusterChildIndexedComponent calls the same slot 'Radius'.

summary: Client scene clustering: the integer cell key (x, y, z, level) of a cluster entity, the same Vector4i that keys ls::ClusterContainerComponent's HashMap<ivec4, EntityHandle>; set by ls::ClusterSystem::SetupNewCluster / SetupNewHLODCluster / SetupNewCullTriggerCluster. Lives in idle levels on every cluster entity.
open_questions: Name of the 4th member ('Level' here) is inferred; it is the power-of-two size exponent of the cell.
